name: Genevieve Auza
insight:
Blocker: None (has Claude access) — though Claude can only connect one inbox at a time, limiting full automation since she needs both service@ and warranty@.
• Manages warranty, parts, and customer service for Epic Hot Tubs; handles 15–40 inquiries/day.
• Current process: customer emails service@ → technician diagnoses via Service Fusion → Genevieve emails manufacturer from warranty@ for pre-approval → manually files claim in Welles Portal → updates customer from service@.
• No formal company tracker exists — claims awaiting manufacturer approval (often 3+ days) get buried and missed; her personal tracker isn't sufficient.
• No canned email templates exist, so every reply — including sensitive disputes — is drafted manually.
• A comprehensive SOP document exists in Google Drive and is frequently referenced.
• Proposed Claude solutions: (1) use Cowork to analyze the warranty@ inbox and build a follow-up tracker sorted by urgency; (2) analyze sent emails and the SOP to build a library of canned email templates.
• Immediate goal is "Inbox Zero" for warranty@, starting with inbox organization and template creation.

name: Bhea Mariel Caryzabel Flores
insight:
• Supports a real estate developer client (30+ years in business) with vendor and contractor quote comparisons for renovation and construction projects
• Client sends quotes via email or WhatsApp; Bhea enters pricing and scope into a Google Sheet, negotiates prices (e.g. a painting quote reduced from $43k to $37k), and builds spec books from scratch for buyers
• Claude replaced Magic GPT for this workflow - Magic GPT produced messy, incomplete tables, while Claude generates clean, direct comparison tables from unstructured text and saves significant time
• Also uses Claude for product research (accurate Amazon/Lowes links, which she double-checks), flexible formatting to match client preferences, and transcribing sensitive meeting notes
• Client is aware of and encourages AI use, and wants Claude to eventually track construction phases and trigger next steps (e.g. prompting to order glass doors after a plumbing inspection)
• Top requested feature: a custom Vendor Coordination skill to automate the quote comparison workflow end to end
• Open to a Microsoft 365 connector despite using a GoDaddy-hosted Outlook, seeing value in a unified workflow
sessionNote: 27 sessions (Jun 18-Jul 8), top adopter: daily EOD reports for a real-estate developer (Marc Charney), vendor quote-comparison tables, procurement pricing, meeting transcription. Deeply embedded.
